system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: At runtime, refinery skills are injected by progressive disclosure. When an agent starts, it sees the names and descriptions of available refinery skills. The full skill text is loaded only when the agent judges that the skill is relevant
system_prompt_style.note: Core role prompts are short and stable; skills injected at runtime.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Each selected paper is converted into a reusable wiki entry, and the wiki pool is shared across topic, idea, and experiment scopes.
env_context_strategy.note: Literature retrieval/wiki injection plus agent-driven workspace navigation (coder debugging, reading files).

observation_format.evidence_quote: we required the system to send rendered videos through Telegram for manual inspection
observation_format.note: Visual artifacts (figures, videos) are handled; the paper also notes agents treat videos as evidence. Text is the default.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The internal loop is experiment-scientist → experiment-coder → experiment-auditor → experiment-scientist
loop_primitives.note: Default: producer–critic loops inside a staged factory pipeline (idea, proposal, experiment, paper).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the dispatcher creates an experiment workspace by copying the upstream topic, landscape, latest idea, and latest proposal, and by initializing STATE.md, LESSONS.md, and experiment-log.md
planning_granularity.note: Versioned proposal specifies the experiment plan; STATE.md persists state across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agon therefore uses prompt dispatchers for system-level orchestration.
multi_agent_topology.note: Dispatcher orchestrates factories; within a factory a dispatcher launches reader/coder worker pools — multi-level.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: deep-literature-dispatcher generates search queries, merges and filters candidate papers, selects papers for full-text reading, launches reader agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: These drafts are reviewed by the human scientist before they become formal topics and start the idea factory.
human_in_loop.note: Human is the final adversary who can block any artifact from advancing; ask_user escalation is also used.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: STATE.md records the current experimental state details and paper-level argument.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: LESSONS.md stores transferable lessons and human instructions.
long_term_memory.note: Also the shared literature wiki pool and refinery skills injected by progressive disclosure.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Inter-agent handoff is therefore mediated by artifacts, which makes the research process recoverable, auditable, and reusable across projects.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The system then pairs a role that produces the artifact with an independent critic that checks it against an explicit standard.
self_verification.note: Auditor/reviewer/killer-reviewer roles; the coder runs experiments but the harness does not run a fixed test suite.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Proposal refinement stops when proposal-reviewer marks the proposal as ready or the proposal reaches the version limit.
retry_policy.note: Loops iterate until the reviewer/critic passes, with a secondary version cap.

rollback.evidence_quote: experiment-log.md is the cross-branch historical record and is not stored in git.
rollback.note: Workspace artifacts are versioned in git; no explicit revert mechanism described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: For an idea with reviewer score s and current version v, refinement stops when v ≥ s − 2.
termination_condition.note: Reviewer 'ready' verdict ends a stage; version limits act as step caps.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: A single role can also be mapped to a mixture of backends, so repeated invocations of the same role may be distributed across models, such as a 50–50 split between two backends.
cost_controls.note: Per-role model configuration motivated by cost control; audit system tracks cost but no hard budget cap is described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: experiment-coder implements the plan, deploys jobs on remote servers, monitors runs, debugs failures, synchronizes outputs, and handles server operations.
execution_isolation.note: Runs on GPU server clusters (CUHK, Purdue, UMD); no container isolation described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The coder deploys models to remote GPUs, manages screen sessions, diagnoses crashes, syncs results, and updates a sweep matrix.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The topic-radar component scans watchlisted X accounts, keywords, and blogs; fetches posts, blog entries, and linked content
network_policy.note: No network restriction described; agents fetch web content and deploy to remote servers.

permission_model.note: No per-action authorisation mechanism described; file permissions per role are mentioned as handoff boundaries.

tracing.evidence_quote: The audit system tracks time, cost, context usage, and tool use for each invocation, and attributes these records to the corresponding research stage and role.

replayability.evidence_quote: Inter-agent handoff is therefore mediated by artifacts, which makes the research process recoverable, auditable, and reusable across projects.
replayability.note: Auditable artifact history but no replay mechanism described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: the human is the final adversary, and the system is designed to produce audit-ready artifacts—state files, experiment logs, audit trails, and per-claim evidence
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner described; benchmarks are discussed only as related work.

guardrails.evidence_quote: We traced the discrepancy to the code, imposes a hard ban, and manually inspects every code path to eliminate the fallback.
guardrails.note: Auditor halts work as a gate; also 'operation prohibitions' preserved in refinery skills.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we implement Agon, a massively parallel, omnidisciplinary, zero-code, minimal-prompt autonomous-research system

open_source.evidence_quote: Agon is open-source, built entirely from natural-language prompts, and will be released at AutoResearch-Factory/Agon.
open_source.note: No LICENSE inspected; release stated as forthcoming.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The current system supports at least Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Agon is open-source, built entirely from natural-language prompts, and will be released at AutoResearch-Factory/Agon.
primary_artifact.note: Coded from the paper; repo not yet available at coding time.

pinned_version.note: No repo commit available; pinned to the paper version.
